title: EU chief to unveil social media, gaming curbs for under-15s
raw_summary: EU chief Ursula von der Leyen will on Wednesday unveil long-awaited plans to protect children from online harm by curbing access to social media, video-sharing platforms, games and AI chatbots for under-15s.
